title: Location

id.description: A unique identifier that the requesting party can send to help identify where deliveries can be batched

name.description: A short description of the location

phone.description: Telephone number for contacting this location

notes.description: Special instructions for access to the location

geofence_radius_in_meters.description: The geofence radius in meters for automated arrival

merchant_phone_suppressed.description: Flag to hide the merchant contact phone number

description: Geographic and contact details for where contents will be picked up from or dropped off.

region_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB

address_lines.description: In order street address line 1, 2, etc.

items.description: In order street address line 1, 2, etc.

cross_streets.description: Usually a rough description of the intersection for delivery.

locality.description: Usually refers to postal town or city.

sublocality.description: Borough, district, an entity with an administrative boundary.

neighborhood.description:
A subdivision of sublocality, with or without a an administrative boundary.
It might also refer to a common name that is associated with the location.

administrative_area.description: State, or some sort of highest level subdivision of the region.

sorting_code.description: Not used in most regions. Sorting code for addressing purposes.

GeoLocation.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates for a location.
